data.body:
rebar-debug Phase 2 repair report.

Problem: impact-present ticket close ran commit_impact.referencing_commits, whose per-candidate historical-reference resolution still performed a full tracker-root os.listdir for every 8-hex short-id and generic-prefix/four-digit candidate (the alias branch was already bounded by 5c64deff). O(unique_candidates x tracker).

Root cause (proven): resolve_ticket_id's _SHORT_ID_RE branch and its len>=4 generic-prefix branch each called os.listdir(tracker_dir) per candidate. Non-alias candidates fall through the alias index (which returns [] for a non-alias) straight into these two branches.

RED-first test: tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py::test_referencing_commits_bounded_scans_for_non_alias_candidates counts tracker-root os.listdir calls during referencing_commits with 50 distinct non-alias candidate trailers (25 short-id-shaped + 25 four-digit) plus an alias-credited target. It failed RED at 52 scans (<=1 required) and is GREEN after the fix. The target commit stays correctly credited.

Fix: added build_resolver_scan_index (one tracker-root pass -> ResolverScanIndex{alias_to_dirs, sorted_dir_names}). resolve_ticket_id gained an optional dir_names= param; the short-id and generic-prefix branches were extracted into _resolve_short_id/_resolve_prefix, which prefix-match the prebuilt sorted dir-name list by bisect (O(log store + matches)) when the index is supplied and otherwise keep the exact per-call os.listdir behavior. referencing_commits now builds the combined index once and threads both alias_index= and dir_names=. build_alias_index is retained as the alias-only view. No semantics changed: same match set, same ambiguity handling, same fail-closed None-vs-[] contract, descendant credit / --ref / file-impact-vs-diff untouched.

Before/after evidence (synthetic large-history repro, 80 distinct non-alias candidates + 1 alias-credited target):
 - before: 82 tracker-root os.listdir scans (1 index build + 80 per-candidate + verify wrap), scaling linearly with candidates.
 - after: 1 tracker-root scan (the single index build), target still credited.
Bounded to one tracker index/build per invocation plus linear code-history parsing, satisfying AC#1/#2/#6.

Parity: tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py::test_indexed_short_id_and_prefix_resolution_matches_per_call proves indexed short-id, unique/ambiguous generic-prefix, and longer-prefix resolution equal per-call scanning (None on ambiguity), pinning AC#3 for the newly indexed branches. Existing alias parity/perf tests remain green.

Gates: complexity baseline --check active=42 new=0 increased=0 (resolve_ticket_id dropped below its ceiling -> stale, the sanctioned improvement; baseline left untouched); make lint and make typecheck (mypy 645 files) clean; 772 resolver/close-related unit tests + 26 attach/alias-perf tests pass. Module sizes: _ids.py 496 LOC, commit_impact.py 218 LOC (< 800 cap).

Scope/safety sweep: build_alias_index/resolve_ticket_id have one production index-caller (referencing_commits); single-id callers keep the default dir_names=None (unchanged path). No new dependency or capability; no test weakened.

Origin (caused_by): 746c1ba2e961 'Add attach-commits verb and impact-vs-diff gate' (ticket cec6-0a0e-38a9-4234) introduced the impact-present landing scan over arbitrary historical candidates; alias sub-case bounded by 4234-821b, this closes the short-id/prefix residual.
